summary: PassKit covers Apple Pay payments and Wallet passes, both of which depend on Apple's payment networks and the Wallet service. BifrOSt has no payment or pass counterpart, and the framework is not planned for the PC desktop.

features.note: Needs Apple Pay merchant accounts and Apple's payment network
Passes are issued and updated through the Wallet app and Apple push service
Apple Pay brand UI for merchants; no BifrOSt equivalent
